blood.name: Blood Coating
blood.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with the essence of blood. Your next primary attack inflicts Leech and Vampiric Curse, dealing 40% magic damage after 2s and spawning a Blood Orb. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

chaos.name: Chaos Coating
chaos.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with blazing chaos. Your next primary attack triggers a Chaos Explosion dealing 50% magic damage in an area and inflicting Ignite. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

frost.name: Frost Coating
frost.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with chilling frost. Your next primary attack triggers a [[|Frost Nova]] dealing 30% magic damage in an area and inflicting Chill. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

illusion.name: Illusion Coating
illusion.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with spectral energy. Your next primary attack triggers an Energy Burst dealing 30% magic damage in an area, inflicting Weaken and granting 4 stacks of Phantasm. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

storm.name: Storm Coating
storm.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with crackling thunder. Your next primary attack deals 40% bonus magic damage and triggers Chain Lightning. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

unholy.name: Unholy Coating
unholy.description: Imbue your equipped weapon with unholy corruption. Your next primary attack deals 40% bonus magic damage, inflicts Condemn and conjures a bone spirit that circles around the target dealing 50% damage and inflicting Condemn to any enemy it hits. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.
